home.description: Multi-speciality hospital at Jindal Chowk, Hisar, Haryana: emergency care, surgery, orthopaedics, obstetrics and gynaecology, with diagnostics, imaging and pathology on the same campus.
home.servicesIntro: Grouped by how you get to them: departments you consult or are admitted under, tests and scans you are referred for, and the services that run alongside your treatment.
home.rosterNote: Consultant profiles are published as LIMS supplies them. For a department not listed here, please contact the hospital.
home.restOfSiteIntro: Departments, diagnostics, patient services and the consultant roster are above. These are the remaining sections in the main menu.

serviceDetail.faqBringQ: What should I bring to my first visit?
serviceDetail.faqBringA: Bring photo ID, earlier reports and scans, a list of your medicines and allergies, and insurance papers if you plan to use them.

awaitingContent.defaultBody: This section is published from information supplied by LIMS and is not yet available. For anything urgent, please call the hospital directly.

visitorsPage.title: Visitor information
visitorsPage.intro: Visiting a patient, ward access and where to come.
visitorsPage.awaitingBody: Visiting hours, attendant passes and ICU access rules are set by the hospital and vary by ward. They are not published here yet, please call before travelling rather than relying on a general figure.

contactPage.title: Contact LIMS Hisar
contactPage.intro: Call the hospital, find it on the map, or send an appointment request. In an emergency, call the emergency number now.
contactPage.mapPrivacy: Nothing is loaded from Google until you choose. The map and Street View connect to Google and may set cookies.
contactPage.streetViewTitle: Street View of the road outside LIMS Hisar
contactPage.streetViewNote: The map and Street View are provided by Google and may set cookies. Street View images may not show recent changes. Use Get directions for the way in.
contactPage.noHoursNote: Opening hours are not published yet. Please call to check before travelling.
contactPage.reviewsLead: A few reviews picked by the hospital. The rating beside them counts every review.
contactPage.reviewsHonesty: The quotes here are reviews we selected. The rating counts every review on Google, the good and the bad.

appointmentsPage.metaDescription: Request an appointment at LIMS Hisar. The hospital calls you back to confirm a time.
appointmentsPage.title: Request an appointment
appointmentsPage.intro: Send a request and the hospital will call you back to confirm a time. For anything urgent, please call instead.
appointmentsPage.introDoctor: Requesting time with {name}. The hospital will call you back to confirm.
appointmentsPage.emergencyHeading: In an emergency, do not use this form
appointmentsPage.emergencyBody: This is a callback request and nobody is watching it in real time. If someone needs care now, call the hospital directly or go to the emergency department.

appointmentForm.patientTypeLegend: Are you a new or an existing patient?
appointmentForm.existingNote: We already have your details on file, so we only need your name and phone number.
appointmentForm.uhidHint: Printed on your OPD card or bills. Leave blank if you don't know it.
appointmentForm.title: Title
appointmentForm.name: Patient name
appointmentForm.ageHint: For a baby under one year, use date of birth.
appointmentForm.guardianHint: Optional. Only if the patient is a child.
appointmentForm.mobileHint: The hospital will call this number to confirm.
appointmentForm.notesHint: Please do not include medical details here. This is a scheduling request, not a consultation.
appointmentForm.termArrive: Please arrive 15 minutes before your confirmed appointment time to complete billing and other formalities.
appointmentForm.termWaitlist: Waitlisted appointments are subject to cancellation of booked appointments.
appointmentForm.accept: I accept these terms and agree that LIMS may call me on this number to confirm my request.
appointmentForm.fixErrors: Please fix the highlighted fields and try again.
appointmentForm.successBody: The hospital will call you back on the number you gave to confirm a time. This is a request, not a confirmed appointment. Please do not travel until LIMS has confirmed.
appointmentForm.notConfigured: Online appointment requests are not connected yet. Please call the hospital.
appointmentForm.deliveryFailed: We could not submit your request just now. Please call the hospital.
appointmentForm.networkError: We could not reach the booking service. Please check your connection, or call us.
